blocks.html: The thickness of panels with tapered cross sections shall be that determined at a distance 2t or 6 inches (152.4 mm), whichever is less, from the point of minimum thickness, where t is the minimum thickness.
blocks.plainText: The thickness of panels with tapered cross sections shall be that determined at a distance 2 t or 6 inches (152.4 mm), whichever is less, from the point of minimum thickness, where t is the minimum thickness.
